title: Plots with matplotlib
intro: Figures drawn with matplotlib show under their code. Random numbers come from the board's seed, so every reader sees the same picture.

nodes.title: Two waves
nodes.code:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
plt.plot(t, np.sin(t), label="sin")
plt.plot(t, np.cos(t), label="cos")
plt.legend()
plt.show()

nodes.title: A scatter plot
nodes.code:
u, v = np.random.random(60), np.random.random(60)
plt.scatter(u, v, c=u + v)
plt.colorbar()
plt.show()
